headline: A 2005 executive order set the order of officials who would lead the Defense Department if top leaders could not serve.
what_it_does: This order lists which Defense Department officials would act as Secretary of Defense if the Secretary and others above them were unable to do the job, such as after a death, resignation, or emergency. No summary was provided, so the exact list and details are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are placed in a set order to temporarily take over the Secretary of Defense's duties if needed.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 22, 2005; exact effective date not stated in the source material.
